placements.why: The envelope's content is a standing operational directive (a fixed rehearsal cadence) plus its warrant — organizational process governance, not product/strategy/architecture content. No existing strata category was supplied to hold this, and nothing close enough exists to relate it to, so it is minted standalone as the org's baseline category for operational-process decisions.
placements.title: Operational practice, cadence, and process governance
placements.frame: Does this content set or justify a recurring organizational practice, cadence, or process decision rather than describe a product, market, or technical architecture?

placements.title: Rehearsal is the condition, not the proof, of genuine operational capability
placements.frame: Does a capability count as actually held only once it has been rehearsed at a fixed cadence, and is the cadence chosen sufficient to keep that claim true over time?
placements.why: src-1 fixes a monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollbacks as a standing order, and src-2 supplies the constitutive warrant — an unrehearsed rollback is treated as no rollback at all. Together they name a recurring subject future envelopes about drills, cadences, and readiness claims will keep feeding: whether preparedness is only real once practiced. This is thematic and forward-looking (the grain test), not a one-time fact, so it earns its own leaf rather than being folded as evidence into something narrower. No existing leaf was supplied to reuse, and nothing close enough exists to warrant a lineage edge, so it is minted new under the Organization strata.
